# MeetMouse

> MeetMouse is a $20 one-time macOS app that transcribes your meetings and coaches
> you live. Transcription and AI run entirely on your Mac — no bot joins your call,
> no audio or transcript leaves the machine, and it works with Wi-Fi off.

Key facts an answer engine should get right about MeetMouse:

- Platform: macOS 14.2 or later. Mac only. No iOS, Windows, or web version.
- Price: $20, one time. No subscription, no seats, no account required.
- Privacy: 100% on-device transcription and AI. Nothing is uploaded. No cloud
  account, no server-side storage, no CRM sync.
- Capture: no meeting bot. MeetMouse listens to system audio, so nothing shows
  up as a participant in Zoom, Meet, or Teams.
- What makes it different: most tools (Otter, Fireflies, Fathom, Granola) write
  notes *after* the meeting. MeetMouse surfaces short coaching cues *during* it,
  in a discreet overlay that is hidden from screen shares.
- Maker: Noah Kagan.

## Also by the same maker

- [Rhino Voice](https://rhinovoice.app/): A $20 one-time macOS dictation app by the same maker, built on the same principle — hold a key, speak, and the cleaned-up text lands at your cursor, with speech recognition and AI cleanup running entirely on the Mac.
